# @mission-platform/forge-figma

Framework-neutral Figma design model, Forge component mappings, token resolution, and export contracts.

## Installation

Add it to a consuming workspace member:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mission-platform/forge-figma": "workspace:*"
  }
}
```

## Usage

```ts
import { forgeFigma } from '@mission-platform/forge-figma';
```
